components.name: Vendor Proprietary RTOS Base Layer
components.description: 벤더 자체 개발 실시간 운영체제 계층. 폐쇄형이며 공개 소스 구성요소를 최소화한다.

components.name: NTP Daemon
components.description: 이벤트 타임스탬프 정합성을 위한 시각 동기화 데몬.

components.name: lwIP
components.description: 경량 TCP/IP 스택. 소형 제어기의 Modbus/TCP 및 진단 웹 통신 경로를 담당한다.

components.name: Expat
components.description: 스트림 방식 XML 파서. 장치 기술 파일과 프로젝트 설정 처리에 사용된다.

components.name: Treck TCP/IP Stack
components.description: 상용 임베디드 TCP/IP 스택. 계측 장비의 이더넷 통신 계층을 구성한다.

components.name: libmodbus
components.description: Modbus RTU/TCP 마스터·슬레이브 프레임 처리 라이브러리.

components.name: zlib
components.description: 펌웨어 이미지와 로그 압축/해제에 사용되는 무손실 압축 라이브러리.

components.name: OpenSSL
components.description: TLS/SSL 및 범용 암호 라이브러리. 장비의 보안 통신 채널과 인증서 처리를 담당한다.

components.name: wolfSSL
components.description: 실시간 제어기용 소형 TLS 라이브러리. 인증서 검증과 세션 암호화를 수행한다.

components.name: CNC I/O Scanner Module
components.description: 원격 I/O 및 필드 모듈과의 주기적 데이터 교환을 담당하는 스캐너 모듈.

components.name: CNC Diagnostics and Event Logger
components.description: 장비 상태 이벤트, 진단 코드, 감사 로그를 수집하고 보관하는 모듈.

components.name: CNC Embedded Web Configuration UI
components.description: 브라우저 기반 설정 및 상태 조회 화면을 제공하는 내장 웹 애플리케이션.

components.name: CNC Control Execution Engine
components.description: 제어 로직 스캔 사이클을 실행하고 I/O 이미지 테이블을 갱신하는 핵심 실행 엔진.

components.name: CNC Secure Boot and Attestation Module
components.description: 부팅 체인 무결성 측정과 서명 검증을 수행하는 보안 부트 모듈.

components.name: CNC Redundancy Management Module
components.description: 이중화 쌍 간 상태 동기화와 무중단 절체를 관리하는 모듈.

components.name: EtherNet/IP CIP Stack
components.description: EtherNet/IP 및 CIP 오브젝트 모델을 구현한 산업용 이더넷 스택.

components.name: Modbus/TCP Protocol Stack
components.description: Modbus TCP 서버/클라이언트 기능. 레지스터 및 코일 접근 요청을 처리한다.

vulnerabilities.description: The Treck TCP/IP stack before 6.0.1.66 allows Remote Code Execution, related to IPv4 tunneling.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: The Treck TCP/IP stack before 5.0.1.35 has an Out-of-Bounds Write via multiple malformed IPv6 packets.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: inffast.c in zlib 1.2.8 might allow context-dependent attackers to have unspecified impact by leveraging improper pointer arithmetic.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: An issue was discovered in libmodbus before 3.0.7 and 3.1.x before 3.1.5. There is an out-of-bounds read for the MODBUS_FC_WRITE_MULTIPLE_COILS case, aka VD-1302.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: An issue was discovered in libmodbus before 3.0.7 and 3.1.x before 3.1.5. There is an out-of-bounds read for the MODBUS_FC_WRITE_MULTIPLE_REGISTERS case, aka VD-1301.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: The Treck TCP/IP stack before 6.0.1.66 allows Remote Code execution via a single invalid DNS response.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: inftrees.c in zlib 1.2.8 might allow context-dependent attackers to have unspecified impact by leveraging improper pointer arithmetic.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: DoTls13CertificateVerify in tls13.c in wolfSSL before 4.7.0 does not cease processing for certain anomalous peer behavior (sending an ED22519, ED448, ECC, or RSA signature without the corresponding certificate). The client side is affected because man-in-the-middle attackers can impersonate TLS 1.3 servers.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: Buffer overflow in the socket.recvfrom_into function in Modules/socketmodule.c in Python 2.5 before 2.7.7, 3.x before 3.3.4, and 3.4.x before 3.4rc1 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted string.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: zlib before 1.2.12 allows memory corruption when deflating (i.e., when compressing) if the input has many distant matches.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: A buffer overflow vulnerability in the icmp6_send_response_with_addrs_and_netif() function of Free Software Foundation lwIP version git head allows attackers to access sensitive information via a crafted ICMPv6 packet.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: A buffer overflow vulnerability in the zepif_linkoutput() function of Free Software Foundation lwIP git head version and version 2.1.2 allows attackers to access sensitive information via a crafted 6LoWPAN packet.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: libexpat through 2.5.0 allows a denial of service (resource consumption) because many full reparsings are required in the case of a large token for which multiple buffer fills are needed.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.

vulnerabilities.description: In wolfSSL through 4.6.0, a side-channel vulnerability in base64 PEM file decoding allows system-level (administrator) attackers to obtain information about secret RSA keys via a controlled-channel and side-channel attack on software running in isolated environments that can be single stepped, especially Intel SGX.

analysis.detail: Identified by SBOM component matching. VEX adjudication (exploitability in this ICS deployment) not yet performed.
